# freeslides.app

## Summary
freeslides.app is a free, browser-based online presentation maker. No login, no signup, no cloud storage required. All data is stored in the browser's localStorage.

## Key Facts
- 100% free, no account required
- Works entirely in the browser (HTML, CSS, vanilla JS)
- No backend, no server, no tracking
- Data stored in localStorage (never leaves device)
- Supports up to 50 slides per presentation
- Export to PDF and JSON
- Import from JSON
- Built-in presentation mode with keyboard navigation
- Multiple slide themes (Default, Dark, Ocean)
- Light and dark mode UI
- Mobile responsive and touch-friendly
- Loads in under 200ms

## Features
- Slide editor with live canvas preview
- Title, body text, and speaker notes per slide
- Drag-and-drop slide reordering
- Full-screen presentation mode
- PDF export via browser print
- JSON export/import for backup
- Slide themes
- Dark mode toggle (persisted in localStorage)
